_comment: SHA-256 pins for the third-party binaries Copper downloads at runtime. The manifest is compiled into the exe (resources.qrc), so a tampered install directory cannot swap the pins together with the binaries. Each entry's url must equal the URL the code downloads from: changing a download URL without updating this file fails the install (fail closed). yt-dlp releases too frequently to pin here; it is verified against the SHA2-256SUMS asset published with each release instead (see DependencyVerifier::verifyAgainstSumsText).
